correctness.rationale: The exact source identity and GRH character estimate give a uniform tail O(log^2(kX)/sqrt(X)); for X=k^(2+delta) this is o(log k/phi(k)). Mertens gives positive prime weight at least (1/c-o(1))e^gamma log k/phi(k) for all eligible primes, while the subtractive product is (2+delta+o(1))e^gamma log k/phi(k). Taking delta to zero and then c to 1/2 proves all quantifiers and counts. p|k excluded from tail because X>=k. The published upper bound completes Theta.

value.rationale: The motivating paper quantifies that almost all constants are negative, leaving the natural magnitude of the positive exceptions unresolved. Proving a uniform positive band and matching lower order for every modulus shows the exceptional set is genuinely as large in order as the known upper bound. This is a meaningful arithmetic sign-structure theorem for a natural invariant.
